findings.current: Just as we had taken Ares Guild through a siege, they would do the same. Now that I was the City Lord, my duty was to defend my castle from the competitors swarming around it and expand my territory as much as possible.
findings.defect: The draft changes the comparison into a future action and explicitly identifies Jin as the City Lord, although the source makes a general statement about the duty of whoever holds the castle.
findings.rationale: 저들도 마찬가지다 means the same already applies to them, while 성주의 의무 describes the holder’s general duty and does not establish that Jin personally bears the City Lord title.
findings.replacement: Just as we had taken Ares Guild by siege, the same was true of them. Now it was a lord’s duty to defend his castle from the competitors swarming around it and expand his territory as much as possible.
findings.source: 우리가 공성(攻城)으로 아레스 길드를 차지했듯이, 저들도 마찬가지다. 이제는 주위에 바글대는 경쟁자들로부터 성을 지켜 내고, 최대한 영토를 넓혀야 하는 것이 성주의 의무였다.

findings.current: At Team Leader Choi’s utterly serious question, I clicked my tongue.
findings.defect: The physical action is changed from smacking his lips to clicking his tongue.
findings.rationale: 입맛을 다시다 denotes smacking or licking one’s lips; clicking one’s tongue is a different gesture with a different emotional implication.
findings.replacement: At Team Leader Choi’s utterly serious question, I smacked my lips.
findings.source: 정색하며 묻는 최 팀장의 모습에, 나는 입맛을 다셨다.

findings.current: “Impossible. You are a monster, are you not? What have you done to the treacherous human?”
findings.defect: The Skeleton King’s blunt, profane accusation is made stiff and polite, omitting 이 새끼 and weakening the comic register.
findings.rationale: 너 이 새끼 몬스터지 is an emphatic, insulting accusation, not the formal tag question “are you not?”
findings.replacement: “No way. You bastard, you’re a monster! What have you done to the treacherous human?”
findings.source: “말도 안 돼. 너 이 새끼 몬스터지! 도대체 간악한 인간을 어찌 한 것이냐!”

findings.current: *What the hell are these two doing?*
findings.defect: The draft turns a profane statement of contempt into a comparatively mild question, losing Jin’s irritation and the punchline’s register.
findings.rationale: 염병들 하고 자빠졌네 is a strongly vulgar dismissal of their ridiculous behavior rather than a genuine request to know what they are doing.
findings.replacement: *These two were acting like fucking idiots.*

findings.current: “As you know, Mr. Jin Taekyung, during the early stages of the crisis, China’s State Council and Standing Committee were reluctant to request help from abroad.
findings.defect: “Standing Committee” is institutionally ambiguous and omits that this is China’s Politburo Standing Committee.
findings.rationale: In this Chinese leadership context, 상무위원회 refers to the Politburo Standing Committee; preserving the full institutional name maintains the source’s political hierarchy.
findings.replacement: “As you know, Mr. Jin Taekyung, during the early stages of the crisis, China’s State Council and Politburo Standing Committee were reluctant to request help from abroad.
findings.source: 진태경 씨도 아시다시피, 사태 초기 중국 국무원과 상무위원회에서는 국외에 도움을 요청하는 것을 탐탁지 않게 생각했습니다.

findings.current: Just as with the assassination of the Wu family this time, they have no choice but to settle for a warning instead of issuing a direct physical threat.
findings.defect: The draft broadens Wu Shaiming’s specific household into the generic Wu family and leaves the target of the direct physical threat unclear.
findings.rationale: 우 쉐이밍 일가 specifically identifies Wu Shaiming’s family, while the contrast explains that the assassination serves as a warning because Odin cannot directly threaten Jin’s side with force.
findings.replacement: Just as when they assassinated Wu Shaiming’s family this time, they have no choice but to stop at a warning rather than pose a direct physical threat to us.
findings.source: 이번에 우 쉐이밍 일가를 암살한 것처럼, 물리적인 위협 대신 단지 경고로 그칠 수밖에 없죠.

summary: The draft contains one unsupported subject/identity shift, one altered physical action, and several meaningful losses of institutional specificity and profane register.
